main_text.l: 1 Reg. 12, v. 28. 30, & 14, 16. Maiores natu Israel, 2 Regum 10, 5. subditi Manassis, 21, v. 9, 22.

Exempla: Dauidis milites, 2 Sam. 21, 17. Subditorum erga Magistratum officia: I. Agnoscere gubernatores suos, non casu, sed Dei consilio praefectos esse. Exempla: Dauid agnoscit Saulem pro Christo Domini, 1 Sam. 24, v. 5, 6, 7, & 26, 9, Abisai similiter Dauidem, 2 Sam. 19, 21. Miphiboseth, v. 26, 27. Adonias, 1 Regum 2, 15. Populus Israel, 3. 28. Daniel, Dan. 2. 37. II. Fauore & amore eos prosequi. Exempla: Iacob, Gen. 47, v. 7, 10, Mulier Thecuitis, 2 Sam. 14. 5, &c. Ioab. ver. 22, Echai, 15, 21, Chusai. v. 31, 32, 33, Berzellai, 19, v. 31, 32, Esaias, 2 Reg. 19, 6, & 20, 7, Mardochaeus, Esth. 2, verf. 21, 22, Daniel, Dan. 6, 21. III. Praestare legibus & mandatis eorum pietati & honestati consentaneis debitam obedientiam. Exempla: Rubenitae & Gaditae, Ios. 13, 8, & 22, ver. 1, 2, subditi Saulis, 1 Sam. 11. v. 14, 15, exercitus saulis, 14, 24, Isai, 16, v. 17, &c. serui Dauidis, 2 sam. 15, v. 13, 14, Banaias, 1 Reg. 2, 25, Nuntius Asae 15. 22, Milites Iehu, 2 Reg. 10, 25.
IV. Conferre sumtus ad gubernationem necessarios, tributum, vectigal, census, decimas, & similia, pro diuersa politiarum ratione, i. Sam. 8, v. 11, &c. Matt. 22, 21. Roman. 13. 7.
V. Æquo animo accipere eorum sententiam, & iustas poenas propter violatas leges. Exempla: Semei, 2. Sam. 19. 19. Miphiboset, verf. 27. 28.

VI. Timere eos, & leui ora quaedam errata iis condonare, ac tolerare eorum iniurias, & sibi temperare ab eorum caede. Exempla: Israel, Iosue 4, 14, populus saulus, 1 sam. 12, 7. Dauid, 24, verf. 9. 10. 11. & 26. 9. Gentes, 1 Paral. 14, 17.
VII. Petere a Magistratu auxilium & defensionem. Exempla: Mulier Thecuitis, 2 sam. 14. 4. Mulier quaedam, 2. Regum. 6. 26. Sunamitis, 8. 3.

VIII. Eternis gestibus suam erga Magistratum declarare reuerentiam Exempla: Iacob, Genes. 28. 4. & 47. 7. Fratres Ioseph, 50. 18, Nathan & Bethsheba submisso in terram vultu, adorauit Dauidem, 1 Reg. 1, v. 23, 31.

IX. Imitari pietatem & caeteras virtutes bonorum gubernatorum. Exempla: Israelitae, Ios. 24. 31. Subditi, Iosiae, 2 Paral. 34. 33. Vide Eccles. 10. 2. X. Orare pro Magistratu, & felicissima quaeque ei precari. Exempla: Subditi saulis, 1 sam. 10. 24. Banaias, 1 Reg. 1. 47. subditi salomonis, verf. 39. subditi Ioas, 2 Regum 11, v. 11, 12, Chaldaei, Ierem. 29.
